name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), Deep-Slumber bindings per loadout, and one-click copy of the loadout you're wearing into another slot.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

added: You can now copy the loadout you're wearing into any of your other loadout slots: open the Loadout Switcher window and click the button with your current loadout's name on the row you want to overwrite. It copies gear, modules, skills, talents, Battle Imagines and the Deep-Slumber binding, after a confirm that warns about unsaved changes or a class change.
